name: Input
description: Text input with optional label, prefix/suffix slots, and a `search` variant. Forwards refs and all native `<input>` attributes

props.name: error
props.description: Validation error message. When provided, displays error styling (red border) and the message below the input

props.name: label
props.description: Optional label displayed above the input

props.name: id
props.description: HTML id for the input. Required when using label for accessibility

props.name: prefix
props.description: Prefix element displayed before the input (left side)

props.name: variant
props.description: Variant of the input - `default`: Standard text input - `search`: Input with magnifying glass icon on the right

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the input - `default`: padding 10px 12px, icon 16px - `medium`: padding 6px 12px, icon 12px

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Custom className for the root wrapper

props.name: suffix
props.description: Suffix element displayed after the input (right side)
